name: Python Guard
summary: Keeps Python working on your Mac through every Homebrew upgrade: installs the matching Tk, rebuilds tool environments for the new version, and heals itself the moment Homebrew changes Python.
story: Every Homebrew Python upgrade quietly breaks something: Tk apps stop opening, private environments point at a Python that no longer exists, and `pip install` is refused outright. Python Guard is the one place every tool in this collection asks for Python. It finds the best interpreter, installs `python-tk` for whatever version Homebrew just switched to, rebuilds each tool's private environment on the new version, and runs again automatically whenever Homebrew relinks python3.

launcher.short: Keep Python + Tk working after Homebrew upgrades
launcher.long: doctor: what's installed and what's broken · ensure: fix it now · install: also watch for Homebrew upgrades and fix automatically.

installs.what: LaunchAgent com.amol.python-guard running a copy of pyenv.sh from ~/Library/Application Support/python-guard
